lessons_used: adoption/redesign changes are helpful, with 3 winning tests showing strong positive impact (+6.9% average after noise correction).
sign_in/hint changes are helpful (+2.5% average after noise correction), backed by 2 winning tests, though recent tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in/reorder changes failed to improve onboarding, showing negative or no clear effect (-4.3% average after noise correction across 2 tests).
choose_path/copy, home/new_screen, home/wait_info, and choose_path/layout changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence is still thin for single-test categories (adoption/incentive, finish/copy, finish/new_flow, finish/new_screen, finish/notification, home/notification).
Predictions consistently overstated weak or unsuccessful ideas while underestimating major winning redesigns.

lessons_next: Redesigning adoption steps (adoption/redesign) is helpful, driving strong gains across 3 winning tests despite a recent non-significant result.
Sign-in reassurance hints (sign_in/hint) proved helpful in early tests (2 wins), though recent iterations showed no clear effect or negative impact.
Reordering sign-in timing (sign_in/reorder) failed to improve onboarding, resulting in negative or no clear effect across multiple tests.
Changes to path selection copy/layout (choose_path/copy, choose_path/layout) and home screens (home/new_screen, home/wait_info) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories (adoption/incentive, home/notification, and all finish/* variations).
Predictions consistently overestimated weak or failing changes while underestimating major winning redesigns.
